hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ "$(uname)" = Darwin ]; then d=$(xcode-select -p 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -x "$d/usr/bin/git" ] || exit 0; fi; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; [ -z "$(git rev-parse --show-prefix 2>/dev/null)" ] || exit 0; git remote get-url origin >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git add -A >/dev/null 2>&1; git diff --staged --quiet && exit 0; git commit -m "auto-sync: $(date +"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")" >/dev/null 2>&1; if git push --quiet 2>/tmp/sabinos-push-err; then rm -f .backup-falhou; else { echo "O backup automatico no GitHub falhou em $(date +%Y-%m-%d) $(date +%H:%M)."; echo "O trabalho esta salvo no computador, mas NAO subiu pra nuvem."; echo "Rode /syncar pra resolver. Erro do git:"; cat /tmp/sabinos-push-err; } > .backup-falhou 2>/dev/null; fi; true' ; exit 0
